bread_mix.text: BANANA BREAD MIX Bake at 350°F 1. Heat oven to 350°F. 2. Mix with 2 eggs, 1/3 cup oil    and 2/3 cup water. 3. Pour into a greased pan. 4. Bake 45 minutes. 5. Cool 10 minutes before slicing. Makes 10 slices. Best before 01/2028

sleep_aid.text: SLEEP AID  Take 1 tablet at bedtime

pain_relief.text: PAIN RELIEF  Take 1 tablet every 6 hours. Do not take more than 4 tablets in 24 hours. Keep away from children.
